mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(a.view_count), 0) FROM article a WHERE a.deleted = 0
SELECT stat_date, pv, uv FROM site_daily_stat WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} ORDER BY stat_date ASC
SELECT article_id, SUM(pv) AS pv FROM article_daily_stat WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY article_id

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.status, a.view_count AS viewCount, a.create_time AS createTime, c.name AS categoryName, COALESCE(u.nickname, u.username) AS authorName FROM article a LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = a.category_id LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = a.author_id WHERE a.deleted = 0 ORDER BY a.view_count DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.status, a.view_count AS viewCount, SUM(d.pv) AS rangePv, a.create_time AS createTime, c.name AS categoryName, COALESCE(u.nickname, u.username) AS authorName FROM article_daily_stat d INNER JOIN article a ON a.id = d.article_id LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = a.category_id LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = a.author_id WHERE d.stat_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} AND a.deleted = 0 GROUP BY a.id, a.title, a.status, a.view_count, a.create_time, c.name, u.nickname, u.username ORDER BY SUM(d.pv) DESC, a.view_count DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(a.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS stat_date, COUNT(*) AS `count` FROM article a WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.status = 1 AND a.create_time >= #{start} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(a.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY stat_date ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO site_daily_stat (stat_date, pv, uv) VALUES (#{date}, #{pv}, #{uv}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE pv = pv + VALUES(pv), uv = GREATEST(uv, VALUES(uv))
INSERT INTO article_daily_stat (article_id, stat_date, pv) VALUES (#{articleId}, #{date}, #{pv}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE pv = pv + VALUES(pv)
